trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take the Ramada free theme park shuttle or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour Denny's (~0.5 miles from hotel) or pick up snacks at a nearby Walmart Neighborhood Market to stock up for the week

day_by_day.notes: Priority tonight: check in quickly and get rest. Stock up on water bottles, sunscreen, and snacks at Walmart or Publix nearby to save money throughout the week. Confirm free shuttle schedule with hotel front desk for the next morning.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle to Magic Kingdom (confirm shuttle time night before — typically departs 8:00–8:30 AM). Arrive early for rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion using Lightning Lane if budget allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland — ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Lightning Lane in advance via app), Peter Pan's Flight, and It's a Small World. Take a midday break during peak heat (12:30–2:30 PM) at a shaded area or the cool interior of the Carousel of Progress. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check app for timing, usually early afternoon).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the nighttime spectacular — Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). This is a must-see and completely included with park admission. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel before departure or bring granola bars/fruit from your Walmart stock-up
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with fish and chips or chicken sandwiches (~$12–15 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable counter-service spots with burgers, rotisserie chicken, and salads (~$13–16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free water is available at any quick-service location. Use the My Disney Experience app to check wait times and grab Lightning Lane selections early. Arrive at rope drop to maximize time before afternoon heat and crowds peak.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Head immediately to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — book the moment the park opens via app). Then ride Test Track and Soarin' Around the World before lines grow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk through the international pavilions — Mexico, Norway (ride Frozen Ever After), China, Japan, Italy, and more. Enjoy free cultural entertainment, street performers, and architecture. Spend time at the PLAY! pavilion and Journey Into Imagination with Figment.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — Luminous: The Symphony of Us (check app for show time, typically 9:00 PM). Watch from World Showcase Lagoon for the best views. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks from hotel or grab a quick pastry at the France Pavilion bakery (Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie) — croissants and quiches ~$5–8
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best budget counter-service options with rotating seasonal dishes, sandwiches, and Asian-inspired bowls (~$12–15)
meals.dinner: Katsura Grill in the Japan Pavilion — affordable Japanese counter service with sushi, udon noodles, and teriyaki (~$13–17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — wear comfortable shoes. The World Showcase is great for free entertainment and cultural experiences. Avoid purchasing food at every pavilion to stay on budget — pick one or two international dining experiences. Check the app for free cultural performances throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM). Rush immediately to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most popular rides — Lightning Lane recommended). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Head to Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land next before lines get long.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land fully — ride Alien Swirling Saucers and enjoy the theming. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check app for show times) — a free, entertaining live show included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show (check app for times, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM) — a spectacular water, fire, and projection show included with park admission. Alternatively, catch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks show. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel or bring snacks
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable and beloved counter-service spots with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (~$10–14)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — classic American counter service with burgers, wraps, and flatbreads in an air-conditioned setting (~$12–15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios has some of Disney's most thrilling rides. Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance is highly recommended — book it the moment the park opens. The Indiana Jones Stunt Spectacular is a hidden gem that many guests skip — don't miss it. Check the app for Star Wars character meet-and-greets in Galaxy's Edge.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom often opens early). Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (book Lightning Lane immediately — this is the most in-demand ride at Animal Kingdom). Then ride Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active, but afternoon works too). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you will get wet — plan accordingly). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular or Tree of Life Awakenings (check app — Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks, typically 8:00–9:00 PM). Enjoy the beautiful Tree of Life projections before heading back to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks or eat at the hotel before departure
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of Disney's best counter-service values with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating (~$13–17)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Avatar-themed counter service with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and unique beverages (~$14–17 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho if riding Kali River Rapids. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan accordingly. The Tree of Life is stunning at night with projection shows — don't leave before seeing it.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at the hotel. Take advantage of the hotel pool. Review photos and memories from the week. This is a great recovery day after four consecutive park days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare (~$10–15) to Disney Springs — Disney's free outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Explore the shops, browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store), visit the LEGO Store, and enjoy the lively atmosphere. Check out the free entertainment and street performers.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs and explore the entertainment options. Consider catching a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy live music at various venues. Return to the hotel via rideshare or arranged transportation.

meals.breakfast: Cook simple breakfast in room if you have a mini-fridge/microwave, or grab items from your Walmart stock-up
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers at a reasonable price (~$12–15) or grab food from the food trucks for ~$10–12
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own personal pizzas at a budget-friendly price (~$10–13 per person), or The Polite Pig for BBQ (~$15–18)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter — no park ticket needed. This is a great day to purchase any last-minute souvenirs, as prices are similar to the parks but the atmosphere is more relaxed. The LEGO Store has free building stations for kids. Check the Disney Springs website for any free live entertainment events scheduled for the day.

day_by_day.date: 2027-06-21 (Sunday - Departure Day / Bonus Park or Relaxation)
day_by_day.morning: Depending on your departure flight time: If flying in the afternoon/evening, use the morning for a final visit to your favorite park or revisit Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions. Alternatively, enjoy the hotel pool, pack, and check out. If flying in the morning, pack the night before, check out early, and take a rideshare to the airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Store luggage with the hotel concierge if needed for a few extra hours. Head to the airport via rideshare (Uber/Lyft ~$25–35 from Kissimmee to MCO) or arrange a shuttle. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for security and boarding.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando with magical memories! Review your trip photos and start planning your next Disney adventure.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast or use remaining snacks from your Walmart stock-up
meals.lunch: If visiting a park in the morning, grab a quick counter-service meal. If heading to the airport, eat at the airport food court (budget ~$12–15)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or on the plane

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11:00 AM — confirm with the hotel. The hotel may store your luggage after checkout if you want a few extra hours at a park or Disney Springs. Rideshare from Kissimmee to MCO typically takes 25–35 minutes depending on traffic. Tip: use any remaining Disney gift card balance or dining credits before leaving the parks. Don't forget to check for any items left in the hotel room safe!

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late night arrival. Flight UA lands at 22:30. Take the hotel shuttle from Orlando International Airport to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle in.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Travel day. Rest and prepare for the week ahead.
day_by_day.evening: Late arrival activity: Grab a quick bite from a nearby 24-hour convenience store or fast food spot close to the hotel. Review your Disney park tickets, download the My Disney Experience app, make any dining reservations, and plan your FastPass/Lightning Lane selections for the week.

meals.breakfast: N/A – Travel day
meals.lunch: N/A – Travel day
meals.dinner: Late-night grab: Denny's or McDonald's near W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (open 24 hours, budget-friendly, ~$10–15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Do not schedule any park activities today. Focus on rest. Set an early alarm for Day 2. Confirm hotel shuttle schedule for Magic Kingdom the next morning. Hotel offers free theme park shuttle – check the front desk for pickup times.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Early Entry & Morning Classics: Take the free hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight before crowds build. Grab a Lightning Lane pass for high-demand rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom – Afternoon Exploration: After lunch, explore Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion), Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise), and Frontierland (Big Thunder Mountain Railroad). Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade at 3:00 PM along Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed (shuttle runs regularly).
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom – Evening Magic & Fireworks: Return to the park for the evening. Experience the iconic 'Happily Ever After' or current nighttime spectacular fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically ~9:00 PM). Stroll Main Street U.S.A. for last-minute shopping and atmosphere before heading back on the shuttle.

meals.breakfast: The Wave… of American Flavors at Disney's Contemporary Resort (moderate, ~$20–25/person) OR grab a quick pastry and coffee at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom (~$8–12)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – counter service, great clam chowder and sandwiches (~$15–18/person)
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. – table service, classic American comfort food, moderate pricing (~$25–35/person). Reserve in advance via My Disney Experience app.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen and a refillable water bottle. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (90°F+) with afternoon thunderstorms likely – pack a small poncho. Purchase a Genie+ pass (~$29/person) for Lightning Lane access to maximize ride time. Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park – a great energizing start to the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Morning Rush: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Galaxy's Edge. Ride Rise of the Resistance (book a boarding group or Lightning Lane immediately upon entry). Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Book a Savi's Workshop lightsaber-building experience (~$249.99/lightsaber) if budget allows – reserve well in advance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios – Afternoon Entertainment & Rides: Explore Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers). Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show. Visit the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Watch the Star Wars: A Galaxy Far, Far Away stage show in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios – Fantasmic! Nighttime Show: End the day with Fantasmic!, Disney's spectacular nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, fireworks, and beloved Disney characters. Check show times at the park (usually two showings in the evening). Head back to the hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel continental breakfast at Ramada (included or low-cost) OR grab a quick bite at Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge – Ronto Morning Wraps are a fan favorite (~$12–14)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed counter service with creative dishes (~$15–20/person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – unique drive-in movie atmosphere, American classics, table service (~$25–35/person). Reserve in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is extremely popular – arrive early. Galaxy's Edge experiences like Savi's Workshop and Oga's Cantina require advance reservations. Oga's Cantina is a fun, themed bar experience (non-alcoholic options available for kids). Genie+ is highly recommended for this park. Afternoon storms are common – plan indoor shows/experiences around 2–4 PM.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT – Future World & Morning Rides: Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Start with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane – book immediately at park open). Then ride Test Track and Soarin' Around the World in Future World. Visit the new Journey of Water – Inspired by Moana walking trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT – World Showcase Food & Culture Tour: Begin the World Showcase exploration at noon when pavilions open. Sample authentic cuisine and drinks from Mexico (La Cava del Tequila), Norway (School Bread pastry), China, Italy, and France. Watch the Reflections of China or Impressions de France films. Explore the cultural exhibits and artisan shops in each pavilion. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT – EPCOT Forever Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule). Enjoy a leisurely dinner in the World Showcase before the show. Take the shuttle back to the hotel after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion – counter service with fresh, healthy options like grain bowls and sandwiches (~$12–16/person)
meals.lunch: World Showcase food stalls and quick-service kiosks – graze through multiple countries. Budget ~$20–25/person for a variety of small plates and drinks across 3–4 countries
meals.dinner: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria in the Italy Pavilion – authentic Neapolitan pizza, table service (~$25–40/person). Reserve in advance. Alternatively, Spice Road Table in Morocco for Mediterranean tapas with lagoon views (~$20–30/person).

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most food and culture-focused park – perfect for a balanced, immersive experience. The World Showcase is a highlight for families interested in global cultures. If traveling with young children, the Kidcot Fun Stops in each pavilion are free and engaging. Pick up a World Showcase Passport booklet (~$12) for kids to collect stamps at each country. EPCOT is also the most walkable park – comfortable shoes are essential.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safaris & Avatar: Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop and head to Pandora – The World of Avatar first. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane highly recommended – this is one of Disney's most popular rides). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a gentler experience through the bioluminescent forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom – Safari & Nature Exploration: Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safaris experience – see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and hippos in a naturalistic savanna setting. Best wildlife activity in the afternoon when animals are more active. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (prepare to get wet!).
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom – Rivers of Light & Dining: Catch the Tree of Life Awakenings light show (shown on the Tree of Life at dusk – check schedule). If Rivers of Light or a nighttime show is running, attend before leaving. Head back to the hotel for a relaxed evening. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8–9 PM).

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or pick up snacks at a gas station/convenience store near the hotel to save time and money
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – counter service with healthy, customizable bowls and unique Avatar-themed dishes (~$15–20/person). One of the best quick-service spots on Disney property.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – Asian-fusion cuisine, table service (~$25–35/person). Reserve in advance. Alternatively, Flame Tree Barbecue for counter-service BBQ with beautiful outdoor seating (~$15–18/person).

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the most nature-focused Disney park and is excellent for families. The park is large and involves significant walking on uneven terrain – wear sturdy shoes. Bring bug spray for the outdoor trails. Pandora is stunning at night with bioluminescent lighting effects – if the park has extended evening hours, consider staying late to see it. Kali River Rapids will get you soaked – bring a change of clothes or a poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Hotel Pool Morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and spend time at the hotel pool. This is a great recovery day mid-trip, especially for families with young children who may be experiencing park fatigue. Recharge for the evening's activities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs – Shopping & Exploration: Take the hotel shuttle or a rideshare (~$10–15) to Disney Springs. Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Browse unique shops like World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), LEGO Store, and Uniqlo. Visit the NBA Experience or check out the AMC Disney Springs 24 movie theater if desired. Explore the outdoor entertainment and street performers.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs – Family Entertainment Evening: Enjoy live entertainment at the waterfront stages. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment (~$20–25/person for bowling). Watch street performers and musicians throughout the Springs. Browse the unique dining options and enjoy a relaxed, no-park-ticket-required evening. Take a rideshare or shuttle back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or nearby IHOP/Perkins on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (~$10–15/person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers, counter service (~$15–18/person) OR Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza for customizable personal pizzas (~$12–15/person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – waterfront dining, American seafood and steaks, table service (~$35–50/person). A mid-range splurge for a special evening. Alternatively, Raglan Road Irish Pub for live Irish music, dancing, and hearty pub fare (~$20–30/person).

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter – no park ticket required. This is a great day to save money while still enjoying Disney entertainment and atmosphere. Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney Springs – arrive by 2–3 PM to beat the evening crowds. Parking is free at Disney Springs if driving. The area is entirely outdoors, so bring sunscreen and be prepared for afternoon heat.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom – Final Morning Favorites & Souvenirs: Take the hotel shuttle back to Magic Kingdom for a final morning. Revisit favorite rides with shorter morning wait times. Pick up last-minute souvenirs on Main Street U.S.A. – shop early before crowds arrive. Visit any attractions missed on Day 2. Take photos in front of Cinderella Castle for lasting memories.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure Preparation & Farewell: Return to the hotel by early afternoon. Check out of the Ramada (standard checkout is 11 AM – request late checkout if needed). Pack, organize luggage, and prepare for departure. If flight is in the evening, store luggage at the hotel front desk and enjoy the pool one last time or grab lunch nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Departure: Arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (MCO). Options: hotel shuttle (confirm availability for airport drop-off), rideshare via Uber/Lyft (~$25–35 from Kissimmee to MCO), or rental car return. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security. Safe travels home!

meals.breakfast: Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. – classic hot dogs and breakfast items, quick and affordable (~$10–14/person) OR Crystal Palace for a character breakfast buffet with Winnie the Pooh characters (~$45–55/person, reserve in advance for a special farewell splurge)
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Cafe in Frontierland – counter service Tex-Mex, great value (~$14–18/person) OR grab a quick bite near the hotel before heading to the airport
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or a farewell meal at a nearby Kissimmee restaurant such as Charley's Steak House (~$30–40/person) if time permits before departure

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time and arrange luggage storage if needed for a late flight. Confirm return transportation to MCO well in advance. Orlando International Airport (MCO) is approximately 20–25 minutes from the Kissimmee hotel without traffic, but allow extra time on Sunday evenings. Use any remaining Disney gift cards or dining credits before leaving the parks. Download and save all photos from the My Disney Experience app before your trip ends.

experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride and the magical Na'vi River Journey, especially stunning after dark when bioluminescent plants glow.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Early Morning for Safari, Evening for Pandora
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled evening at Disney Springs exploring unique shops, world-class dining, and live entertainment. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and let kids experience the interactive fountain play area. No park ticket required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late evening
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Arrange private car transfer or Magical Express to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Grab a light late-night snack from the hotel amenities or a nearby 24-hour convenience stop.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night snack at hotel — grab items from the hotel's vending area or order room service if available; alternatively stop at a nearby Denny's or IHOP open 24 hours on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest is essential before a full week of theme park adventures. Confirm your Disney park reservations and MagicBand+ setup tonight if possible. Download the My Disney Experience app and link all tickets. The hotel offers a free theme park shuttle — confirm the morning pickup schedule at the front desk upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Begin with an early arrival via the hotel's free theme park shuttle (depart hotel by 8:00 AM to catch rope drop at 9:00 AM). Start with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass to pre-book top attractions. Head to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (book Individual Lightning Lane in advance).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — enjoy Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Take a midday break during peak heat (1:00–3:00 PM) with a sit-down lunch inside the park. Explore Liberty Square and catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade at its scheduled afternoon time.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular TRON Lightcycle / Run experience in Tomorrowland (book Individual Lightning Lane). Secure a premium viewing spot for the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular at 9:00 PM — consider booking the Fireworks Dessert Party at Tomorrowland Terrace for reserved viewing with desserts and beverages included. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before departure — grab a quick bite or enjoy the hotel's breakfast offering to fuel up before rope drop
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom (Fantasyland) — a premium, immersive Beauty and the Beast-themed dining experience; book via OpenTable or My Disney Experience well in advance
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a signature Disney dining experience with character meet-and-greets, prix-fixe menu, and stunning castle interior; reservations required 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and TRON Lightcycle / Run as early as 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and a portable fan — June in Orlando is hot and humid with temperatures reaching 90°F+. The Fireworks Dessert Party must be booked separately through Disney's dining reservation system.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — Take the hotel shuttle for an early arrival (rope drop at 9:00 AM). Head directly to Galaxy's Edge and join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance, one of Disney's most immersive attractions. Explore the Black Spire Outpost marketplace, interact with droids and stormtroopers, and soak in the incredible theming.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber — a premium, hands-on experience ($299.99 per lightsaber) with a ceremonial, story-driven atmosphere; book in advance as slots fill quickly. Afterward, grab a blue or green milk from the Milk Stand. Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Use Lightning Lane for Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular and the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks and projection show. Dine at a premium Hollywood Studios restaurant before the show. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land upon arrival — try the Breakfast Bowl or Lunch Box Tarts for a fun, themed start
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge — a reservation-required, immersive Star Wars bar experience with unique cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks, and light bites; book 60 days in advance
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — a signature, upscale restaurant inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood supper club; known for the Cobb Salad and premium steaks; reservations required

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are highly competitive — book exactly 60 days before your visit at 7:00 AM EST. Each lightsaber is fully customizable with four different themes. Droid Depot (build your own droid, ~$119.99) is a great alternative or addition for younger family members. Rise of the Resistance virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane must be secured immediately upon park opening.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT via hotel shuttle for rope drop (9:00 AM). Begin in Future World (now World Discovery and World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Individual Lightning Lane required, book at 7:00 AM). Explore the stunning new World Nature pavilion and the Living with the Land boat ride.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enter the World Showcase at 11:00 AM when it opens and begin your culinary and cultural journey. Visit pavilions from Mexico, Norway (ride Frozen Ever After), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample signature dishes and beverages from each country. Participate in the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if running (typically June–November) for additional food booths and celebrity chef experiences.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the evening with the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium lagoon-side table at a World Showcase restaurant for dinner with a view of the show. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — a quick-service option with fresh, healthy options including sandwiches, salads, and rotisserie items; great for a light pre-park meal
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — an upscale teppanyaki dining experience with skilled chefs cooking tableside; reservations recommended
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in the France Pavilion — EPCOT's most refined and elegant dining experience, a French haute cuisine restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse; prix-fixe menu with exquisite wine pairings; reservations required 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is a food lover's paradise — budget extra for food booth tastings if the Food & Wine Festival is active. Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind uses a virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane — secure your spot at exactly 7:00 AM. Consider the EPCOT International Festival experiences for live cooking demonstrations and celebrity chef meet-and-greets. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as World Showcase is a 1.3-mile loop.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive via hotel shuttle for rope drop (8:00 AM, Animal Kingdom often opens earliest). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar and ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Individual Lightning Lane highly recommended — book at 7:00 AM as this is one of Disney's most popular rides). Experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning boat ride through a bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-air vehicle tour through a 110-acre savanna where you'll see lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, hippos, and more. Morning or early afternoon offers the best wildlife activity. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Catch the Festival of the Lion King live show — a spectacular Broadway-caliber performance.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (if running) or enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show as the park winds down. Dine at a premium Animal Kingdom restaurant before the evening show. Return to hotel via shuttle for an early night — you've earned it!

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel before departure — fuel up with a hearty meal; alternatively grab a quick bite at Zuri's Sweets Shop near the park entrance upon arrival
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant — Animal Kingdom's premier signature dining experience, celebrating the art of travel and exploration with globally inspired cuisine; stunning artwork and an intimate atmosphere; reservations required
meals.dinner: Nomad Lounge adjacent to Tiffins — a sophisticated lounge with craft cocktails, small plates, and a relaxed atmosphere; perfect for a lighter, elegant evening meal with unique global flavors

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is consistently one of the most sought-after Lightning Lane Individual selections at Disney World — book at exactly 7:00 AM on your visit day. Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan accordingly. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor trails and safari areas.

day_by_day.morning: Luxury Resort & Spa Morning — Take a well-deserved rest morning. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Consider upgrading your experience with a visit to a nearby luxury Disney resort spa — the Senses Spa at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa offers world-class treatments including massages, facials, and body wraps. Book a 90-minute couples or individual massage to rejuvenate tired legs and feet. Explore the Grand Floridian's stunning Victorian architecture and grounds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Afternoon — Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) via hotel shuttle or rideshare. Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and unique boutiques. Enjoy the Splitsville Luxury Lanes for premium bowling and entertainment. Check out the NBA Experience for interactive basketball activities.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Evening — Enjoy live entertainment from street performers and musicians throughout the Springs. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 with DINE-IN Theatres for a premium cinematic experience. Explore the unique dining options and enjoy a spectacular dinner at one of Disney Springs' celebrity chef restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the hotel — take your time and enjoy a full meal before your spa morning
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — an upscale waterfront restaurant featuring premium steaks, fresh seafood, and classic American fare; dine on the open-air deck overlooking the water with views of the vintage amphicars
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant featuring stunning interior design, a dramatic two-story space, and an exceptional menu of sushi, dim sum, and Asian-inspired dishes; one of the finest dining experiences in all of Orlando

day_by_day.notes: Senses Spa at the Grand Floridian is open to all Disney guests, not just resort guests — book treatments well in advance as appointments fill quickly. Disney Springs is free to enter and offers complimentary parking in the multi-level garages. This is a great day to purchase any remaining Disney souvenirs and gifts. The BOATHOUSE also offers unique Amphicar tours of the waterway — a fun, quirky experience for the family.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom or EPCOT Return Visit — Choose your favorite park for one final magical morning. If returning to Magic Kingdom, focus on any attractions missed earlier in the week — try the new TRON Lightcycle / Run if not yet experienced, or revisit family favorites. If choosing EPCOT, explore any World Showcase pavilions not yet visited and enjoy the calmer morning atmosphere. Use remaining Lightning Lane credits wisely.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir Shopping & Farewell — Spend the early afternoon wrapping up any final souvenir shopping at the park or return to Disney Springs for last-minute gifts. Head back to the hotel by 2:00–3:00 PM to pack, check out, and prepare for departure. Store luggage with the hotel concierge if needed for a late checkout. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic with the family.
day_by_day.evening: Departure Preparation — Arrange private car transfer or rideshare to Orlando International Airport for your return flight. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before departure for check-in, security, and boarding. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport's premium dining options — Orlando International Airport's Terminal C features several upscale dining choices.

meals.breakfast: Grand Floridian Café at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort (accessible via Disney monorail from Magic Kingdom) — a charming, elegant café serving classic American breakfast favorites in a beautiful Victorian setting; a perfect final Disney breakfast
meals.lunch: Quick-service lunch inside the park or at Disney Springs — try Frontera Cocina (Rick Bayless's Mexican restaurant at Disney Springs) for a premium, chef-driven farewell lunch
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport — Kona Grill or another upscale airport option; alternatively enjoy an early dinner near the hotel before heading to the airport

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11:00 AM — request a late checkout (1:00–2:00 PM) in advance if needed to maximize your final morning. Confirm your return flight details and arrange airport transportation the night before. Consider purchasing a Disney Memory Maker photo package if not already done — it includes all PhotoPass photos taken throughout the week and is a wonderful keepsake. Leave a review for the hotel and any exceptional cast members who made your trip special.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
